# Description

Thank you for opening a Pull Request!
Before submitting your PR, there are a few things you can do to make sure it goes smoothly:

- [ ] Follow the [`CONTRIBUTING` Guide](https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Make your Pull Request title follow the Conventional Commits specification and repository rules (e.g., `docs(spec):` for `docs/specification.md`, `docs:` for other docs, and `feat:` / `fix:` reserved for `a2a.proto`). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conventional-commits) for details.
- [ ] Ensure the tests and linter pass (Run `bash scripts/format.sh` from the repository root to format)
- [ ] Appropriate docs were updated (if necessary)

## Partner PRs

If this PR adds your company to the partners list, follow the [Partner PR Guide](https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/main/PARTNER_GUIDE.md) and confirm:

- [ ] My company builds a product or service on A2A (not a personal project or a separate protocol)
- [ ] I added one line to `docs/partners.md`, in alphabetical order
- [ ] My landing page is public and every link in this PR resolves
- [ ] I included a public proof of A2A usage (blog, press release, or docs)
- [ ] My agent card (if provided) resolves and advertises A2A 1.0
- [ ] The PR title is `docs: add <Company> to partners list`

Fixes #<issue_number_goes_here> 🦕
